referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Raw materials, processing energy, emissions to air and water from process, energy services and transports, infrastructure only partly included, no infrastructure of main process included, no land use data included.
referenceFunction.name: Tetrachloroethylene, at plant

technology.text: Data refers to actual technology used in the companies included. This leads in total to an average value including all important production routes for this chemical

timePeriod.text: Time of literature publication. Measurements took place before this period.

representativeness.productionVolume: 0.164 Mt produced and 0.078 Mt sold in Europe in 1994
representativeness.samplingProcedure: Data represent a large share of the European production. Due to the cummulated data source for the product system invetory there are important parameters as land use or soil emissions missing in this dataset. Considered are only emissions stated in the original source of Boustead.
representativeness.uncertaintyAdjustments: Uncertainty for LCI results cannot be determined. Terefore uncertainity set to 1 which means no uncertainity is included
